question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and should that contract be a static release artifact, an authenticated runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: This would turn Gateway route/RPC/schema details into a supported external API contract, so automation should not choose the exposure, auth, versioning, and compatibility model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers decide the schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Existing Protocol Schemas
options.body: Use the existing TypeBox/draft-07 JSON Schema pipeline as the supported generation surface only if maintainers explicitly document that decision.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers decide the schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest adjacent history for generated schema/OpenAPI work and current TypeBox protocol schema docs.
